diagram_math_checks.objects: Euclidean action on E=R^2 and four side walls of Q=[0,1]^2.
diagram_math_checks.check: r1(x,y)=(-x,y) fixes x=0; r2(x,y)=(2-x,y) fixes x=1; s1(x,y)=(x,-y) fixes y=0; s2(x,y)=(x,2-y) fixes y=1. All maps have domain/codomain E and square to the identity. Vertical lines are blue, horizontal lines red; Q is exactly the shaded central unit square.

diagram_math_checks.objects: Two disconnected graph edges on vertices r1,r2,s1,s2.
diagram_math_checks.check: r2 r1 sends (x,y) to (x+2,y); s2 s1 sends (x,y) to (x,y+2), so each parallel pair product has infinite order. Every ri and sj commute because they change separate coordinates, and their product is a nonidentity involution; cross-pair labels are 2 and no cross edges are drawn. The actual native image has four vertices and exactly two edges, each labelled infinity; every vertex has degree one.
diagram_math_checks.local_justification: Verification 1.4 and 2.3; local diagram convention def-cg-coxeter-diagram-components-and-finite-type (1), standard affine diagram def-cg-standard-affine-diagrams (1).

diagram_math_checks.objects: Abstract four-dimensional Coxeter form, distinct from the depicted Euclidean plane.
diagram_math_checks.check: In generator order (r1,r2,s1,s2), diagonal entries are 1; within-pair m=infinity gives -1 and cross-pair m=2 gives 0, so the Gram matrix is A direct-sum A with A=[[1,-1],[-1,1]]. A(a,b)=(a-b,b-a), so ker(A)=R(1,1), rank(A)=1. The full radical is R(1,1,0,0) direct-sum R(0,0,1,1), rank two and corank two. The caption explicitly distinguishes this form from the two-dimensional Euclidean action and makes no whole-matrix connected affine-type claim.

diagram_math_checks.objects: Neighboring unit grid squares and closed-square representative.
diagram_math_checks.check: The drawn finite patch is a subset of the integer grid. Separate factors send [0,1] to [2k,2k+1] or [2k-1,2k], giving all unit intervals, hence their products give all unit squares with disjoint interiors. The drawing asserts no extra orbit arrows or boundary identifications. Unique representatives even on the boundary are delegated explicitly to the unchanged proof 3.1, not inferred from shaded areas.
diagram_math_checks.local_justification: Verification 3.1; the rigorous verification is independent of the illustration.
